hypothesis: Preserving square identity removes redundant clones and enables the existing exact binomialSquare kernel for both model adapters.
scope: 72 square cases plus 192 existing arithmetic cases in two contexts, then 8 fresh serial model prefix processes.
primary_metric: Native evaluation seconds, mean of two processes per variant; setup and request wall time retained separately.
limitations: Small trial; no statistical significance or full-model speedup claim. No automatic retry or expanding experiment search.
